description: Evidence-graded census and scoring registry of GenAI, ML, infrastructure, enterprise-platform and governance certifications (Reduce Step R1, decision D-026). Reconciles RP2 sessions T0-29, T0-30, T0-31, T0-32 and T0-34 with T3-01, T3-02 and T0-11.

hiring_signal.description: Measured share in large systematic job-posting audits (0–10 calibrated to the observed market ceiling where ~10% of target-role postings = 8.5–9.5). Left null whenever only small convenience samples or vendor claims exist; scripts/rank_credentials.py omits null hiring_signal and re-normalises the remaining five weights to sum to 1.0.

channel_value.description: Partner-programme tier counts, FDE gates, SI/client staffing clauses and employer capability mandates.

rigour.description: Proctoring, live hands-on lab/practical assessment, public verification, renewal rules and resistance to brain-dumps or LLM assistance.

currency.description: Blueprint recency (2025–2026 GenAI/agentic/governance updates) net of retirement or short-validity churn risk.

cost_efficiency.description: Inverse of exam/bundle fee and preparation-hour burden (lower cash and time cost scores higher).
